notes.title: New Story Mode!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]The wait is nearly over! On [b]September 18, 2025[/b], a massive update will arrive bringing a brand-new [b]Story Mode: Kneel or Rise[/b] to Conquero.[/p][p]In this epic story-driven mode, your loyalty to the Emperor will be put to the ultimate test. Will you kneel and serve the Empire faithfully… or rise against it and forge your own destiny?[/p][p]More updates are coming soon, and I can’t wait to share them with you![/p][p]Tugrul[/p]

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content:
Dear Conquero Fans,

I want to take a moment to say THANK YOU for your incredible support during Steam Next Fest! 🎉 Your wishlists, playtime, and feedback mean the world to me. Seeing so many of you enjoy the game and share your thoughts has been truly inspiring.

As a solo developer, your support keeps me motivated to make Conquero the best experience possible. I can’t wait to share more with you as development continues. Stay tuned for updates, and if you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist and follow to stay up to date!

Once again, thank you for being part of this journey—I couldn’t do it without you! ❤️

[i]Tugrul Kavasgil (Conquero Developer)[/i]
